spans.s: श्रम a vikarana or conjugational sign of the agama type to be inse- rted after the last vowel of the roots of the seventh conjugation ( रुधादि ): e.g. रुणद्धि, भिनत्ति etc.; cf. रुधादिभ्यः श्रम्
श्रद्धा a technical term for noun- stems ending in आ in the feminine gender used in the Katantra Gra- mmar; cf. अा श्रद्धा Kat.

श्रमणादि a class of words headed by the word श्रमणा with which words in the masculine or the feminine gender are compounded when they stand in apposition; cf. कुमारी श्रमणा कुमारश्रमणा, युवा अध्यापकः युवाध्यापक: Kas. on
श्रवण hearing of a phonetic element or a word in the actual speech; audition; cf. तस्य चोदात्तस्वरितपरत्वे श्रवणं स्पष्टम् S. K. on

. In many technical grammatical terms, affixes and substitutes, there is sometimes a portion of them which is not a vital part of the word, but it is for the sake of causing certain pre- scribed grammatical operations. The letters or syllables which form such a portion are called इत् and they are only for the sake of gra- mmatical operations (कार्यार्थ ), as contrasted with the other ones which are actually heard (श्रुत्यर्थे or श्रवणार्थ ).
श्राविन् lit. that which is heard; cf. श्रवणं श्रावः । भावे घञ् । सोस्यास्तीति श्रावी Nyasa on Kas.
. The term is used in connection with an affix for which no elision is prescribed and hence which remains and is heard: cf. संशये श्राविणं वक्ष्यति M. Bh. on
श्रतिसामान्य common hearing; com- mon form of technically different wordings, such as अा of टाप्, डाप् and चाप् feminine affixes, or ई of ङिप्, ङिव्, and ङीन् fem. affixes; cf. र
स्रज्ञाभूत (1) that, which by usage has become a technical word possessed of a conventional sense: cf. किं पुनर्यानि एतानि संज्ञाभूतानि अाख्यंनानि तत्र उत्पत्त्या भवितव्यम् , M. Bh. on
; (2) which stands as a proper noun or the name of a person; cf. संज्ञाभूतास्तु न सर्वादयः S. K. on
स्रत् a short term used for the affixes शतृ ( अत् ) and शानच् ( अान ) which are applied to roots to form the present and the future participles; cf. तौ सत् P
